test_list.description: Lines naming .cargo\registry or .cargo\git are dropped as well as the forward-slash form.
A custom CARGO_HOME registry path is treated as third party.
A project path like my-registry/src is not mistaken for the cargo registry.
Warning-only blocks vanish when any error block exists.
With no error block, warnings are kept.
`error: could not compile` and `aborting due to` are not diagnostic blocks.
Identical consecutive note/help lines and identical consecutive blocks collapse.
Source frame lines containing | or ^ are removed.
Indented continuation lines of a multi-line note are kept.
Terminal escapes in the input never reach the filtered view.
filter_text of a JSON stream renders its diagnostics as text blocks.
parse_diagnostics on text finds code, message, Windows-path location and details.
The same error from JSON and text yields the same headline, hence the same ledger id.
An error present as JSON and as rendered text appears once.
proptest: every non-empty output line is a substring of an input line.
proptest: arbitrary bytes filter without panic and without ESC in the output.
